episode.descriptionJp: 竜胆祭、そして地区予選に向け、エンジン全開の9人。104期でのLink to the FUTUREを完成させるべく、練習を重ねる1年生だったが……。
episode.descriptionEn: With the Rindo Festival and regional qualifiers ahead of them, the nine are running at full throttle. The first-years keep practicing in order to complete the 104th term's Link to the FUTURE, but...
